MP3 encoding uses @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7 (unmodified), LGPL-3.0.
LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
Upstream: https://github.com/gideonstele/lamejs
Exact npm gitHead: 1fb0ef5fa177413107e2e107d054a9b994e3f79c
The upstream source archive, unmodified distributed JS, upstream notice, LGPL-3.0
and GPL-3.0 texts accompany this application in third-party/lamejs.

KurAudio application source and build files accompany the release in
third-party/relink/KurAudio-source.zip. Extract it, run npm ci, replace
@breezystack/lamejs with a compatible modified version, run npm run package:source,
then build with Rust/MSVC and npm run tauri -- build --bundles nsis -- --jobs 2.
See README.md for the required Windows toolchain.

Permission is granted to use the accompanying KurAudio application code to
recombine/relink it with a modified version of the LGPL-covered library and run
that modified application for your own use. Reverse engineering for debugging
such library modifications is permitted. There is no publisher signature or
signature check preventing execution of such a rebuilt application.
